note: Endings that mark a demonym or an adjective made from a place name. Greek endings are written without accents or breathing marks and compared with the lemma after the same stripping. Used by backend/entity_lemma_audit.py, and only for entities of type place. The exempt list names (entity, lemma) pairs whose ending is part of the place's own name.

exempt.why: the ending is part of the place's own name (Piraeus), not an adjective
